title: Track torque demand
text: During normal thermal operation, delivered normalized torque must stay within 0.10 of the reference request after settling.

title: Report a missing temperature signal
text: By the third missing temperature sample, the diagnostic output must report a temperature signal fault.

title: Limit torque during overheating
text: After two settling samples above 103 degrees Celsius, delivered normalized torque must stay at or below 0.42.

title: Report available energy
text: After initialization, the energy estimate must stay within 0.06 of the simulator reference.

title: Start the range extender at low charge
text: With available energy continuously below 0.30, the generator must be enabled by the third low-charge sample.

title: Clear the temperature warning after recovery
text: After three consecutive valid cool samples following a temperature dropout, the diagnostic output must show normal status.
